svg.title: Brown thermal noise: discrete Langevin field amplitude, retry draw reuse, and Boltzmann validation
svg.desc: Panel (a) shows the discrete stochastic Brown field H_{th,i}^n = sigma_i^n xi_i^n with bare gamma_{mu0} in the denominator (single Gilbert factor 1/(1+alpha^2) applied by LLG), along with the adaptive RK rejected-step raw-draw reuse contract and lane-specific integrator limits. Panel (b) plots the Boltzmann equilibrium distribution P(theta) proportional to sin(theta) exp(xi cos(theta)) with 95% statistical confidence intervals, contrasting ensemble statistical parity against invalid bitwise trajectory equality across CPU and GPU.
svg.text: Thermal Brown Noise: Stochastic Field Contract and Statistical Qualification
Discrete Langevin amplitude with bare γ_μ0, rejected-step draw reuse, and Boltzmann equilibrium validation
Discrete Brown Field, Single-Gilbert Guard & Retry Contract
Hth,in = σin ξin, ξin ~ N(0, I3), ⟨Hth,i,an Hth,j,bm⟩ = (σin)2 δij δab δnm
σin = √[ 2 αi kB T / ( γμ0 μ0 Ms,i Vi Δtn ) ]
Bare γμ0: 1/(1+α2) applied ONCE in LLG
• FDM volume: Vi = ΔxΔyΔz. FEM volume: nodal / lumped-mass measure (zeroed outside Ωm).
• No standalone Eth energy term; seed > 0 fixed deterministic, seed=None requests OS entropy, seed=0 rejected.
Rejected Adaptive Trial (err > tol) → Shrink Δtretry < Δttrial
REUSE same raw Gaussian draw ξin; rescale ONLY σi(Δtretry) ∝ Δtretry−1/2.
Never redraw fresh noise on rejected trials (biases step-size acceptance).
Current Executable Integrator & Backend Lane Boundaries
• FDM CPU & GPU: Fixed-step Heun recommended (ABM3 & adaptive rejected; other fixed RK lack SDE qual.); use Heff.
• FEM CPU: Reference sampler (mt19937_64) implements retry raw-draw reuse & disables FSAL.
• FEM GPU: Strictly UNSUPPORTED in planning (CAP-THERM-GPU-001 pending; kernel source alone != lane).
Type note: ThermalNoise.seed annotation says int|None; harden constructor with strict positive-int check.
Statistical Qualification: Boltzmann Equilibrium & Ensemble CIs
Macrospin Equilibrium Density P(θ) vs Polar Angle θ (ξ = MsVBext/kBT = 2.0)
Peq(θ) = [ξ / (2 sinh ξ)] sin θ exp(ξ cos θ) (Leliaert et al. 2017; Brown 1963)
Polar angle θ relative to applied field [rad]
• Same seed replays ONE fixed lane;
• Deterministic ODE checks miss SDE bugs.
• Var(Hth) ∝ T · α / (γμ0 μ0 Ms V Δt).
• Equilibrium P(θ) within CIs across Δt
ThermalNoise applies bare γ_μ0 in σ and requires physical-time LLG stages (not deterministic relaxation).
